notes.title: Hope Despair Chaos Release on Nov 8, 2021
notes.content:
https://i.ibb.co/fStMKVg/600x200-summary.png
Game Summary
A real time social deduction game with Talents ( skills ) combine with Factions (winning condition), real time lightning, flashlight management and hiding in shadow.
New Trailer just drop, visit Store page now ! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1784410?utm_campaign=prerelease_nov8&utm_source=steam&utm_medium=oripost&utm_content=directlink

https://i.ibb.co/QbGHjkg/600x200-events.png
Events starting on Release day
[olist]
 Hope Coins Daily: collect Hope Coins and have a chances to get your favorite cloths.
 HDC Birthday: join this yearly event to collect special items, also directly craft special cloth set.
 Double Release Clothset #1 and #2: Both clothset are craftable and available in shop for a limit time. check them out !
[/olist]


Sneak peek
The designs of new Coins and clothsets
https://i.ibb.co/mB3zjSf/600x600-sneakpeak-at-release.png


https://i.ibb.co/0rHjqnN/600x200-changelogs.png
Version 0.2 change logs

 Improve News n Events panel, 1 click to game news hub.
 Improve Bugs n Ideas panel, 1 click to game disscussion forums.
 From this verison, all players have a chance to get a certain amount of Hope Coins base on their play times. Use Hope Coins to craft chest and obtain your favorite cloths.
 Item library to track all items in the game from coins to cloths, also crafting and chest opening.
 1 click to Item Shop available for everyone, go here to directly get the cloth you want, also support the developers.
 You only need one copy of a cloth to wear it on your character in game. Feel free to trade or market your surplus cloths as you want. Most of cloths are tradable, marketable following Steam policy. 



Playtest Version 0.1
Playtest registeration has been discontinued, thanks everyone and don't forget to download new version on the Release day.
